title: Named TExeter Thought Leader after one year
summary: After TExeter's first year, company leadership recognized me as its Thought Leader for building a brand for knowledge sharing and for setting up the attitude and processes the next organizers needed to carry it on.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: this is a recognition.
the_call: Not applicable: this is a recognition.
what_i_did: Started and ran the community's events end to end for a year, found people to run them and prepared the next group to take over.
what_changed: Formal recognition from the managing director and HR head, with the next group of organizers ready to carry TExeter on.
